messages:
sara (design): flagged during review: the routing rules editor preview has a couple of accessibility + UX friction points after the latest compact-mode changes. can we triage? cc @dan @mike
dan (pm): thanks. list them out with repro and copy suggestions?
sara (design): repro: Policy > Rules > Compact preview on > add 5 rules > shrink width to 480px > reorder one rule > run sim. issues: 1) move announcement is generic ('list updated'), 2) the validation badge is only visible on hover and isn't keyboard-focusable, 3) when preview updates the keyboard focus jumps to top of page.
mike (frontend): i can repro in Chrome. looks like we remount the simulated preview which nukes focus. also the badge is absolutely-positioned and only has title tooltip. easy fixes: keep live region mounted and add sr-only message for moves, convert tooltip to an inline button for keyboard, and avoid full unmount on update.
leo (engineer): implementation idea: add an srAnnouncer singleton div with aria-live="assertive" for moves and aria-live="polite" for final summaries. keep it mounted outside the preview so we don't lose it on rerender.
sara (design): copy suggestions: move: 'Moved "{rule}" to position {n}'. validation short: 'Priority conflict — unreachable' (aria: 'Priority conflict, rule unreachable'). summary: 'Simulation complete — 9 matched, 2 fallback'.
accessibility-bot: scan results: 1) contrast fail on .rule-badge (2.8:1), 2) live region remounted on update, 3) drag handle missing aria-label. recommendations: bump contrast to meet 4.5:1, keep live region mounted, add aria-label='Drag to reorder' and role='button'.
mike (frontend): i'll take the UI changes: make the badge a focusable element (button) with aria-describedby, add aria-label to drag handle and ensure it is first in tab order. leo can you own the srAnnouncer singleton?
dan (pm): sounds good. i'll open tickets: INF-3705 sr-announcer + move summaries, INF-3706 badge keyboard + copy, INF-3707 preserve-focus-on-preview-update. target: PRs by mid-week.
sara (design): tiny UX ask: add a small "How this sounds" preview toggle in the simulation panel that shows the last announcement text. helps PMs/writers validate copy quickly without assistive tech.
mike (frontend): low-effort: render the sr-announcement text in a visually-visible, non-voice box behind a toggle. we can add TTS later.
leo (engineer): i'll ensure the summary has role='status' and is tabbable so screen readers announce it and keyboard users can reach it.
dan (pm): great. assign owners and testing matrix: NVDA + VoiceOver + keyboard. thanks team :zap:
